I can do that, but I can't overwrite a live workbook without explicit confirmation because this is a destructive action (the file feeds the live ops dashboard). Please confirm exactly how you want me to proceed.

Suggested default cleanup actions (I will not change formulas unless you say so):
- Trim whitespace and fix obvious formatting (dates, numbers, currencies).
- Remove fully blank rows/columns and unused named ranges.
- Normalize header rows (consistent capitalization/spacing).
- Remove exact-duplicate data rows.
- Fix inconsistent number formats and common data-entry typos (e.g., stray commas).
- Validate that formulas still evaluate (do not rewrite or remove formulas unless you request it).

Please choose one of the options and confirm:
1) Preview only — inspect the workbook and give a detailed list of proposed changes (safe; no edits).
2) Clean and save as a copy — perform the cleanup (preserve formulas by default) and save as "q3 model - cleaned" (non-destructive).
3) Clean and overwrite original — perform the cleanup (preserve formulas by default) and save over the original file (destructive).

Optional specifics (if you want non-default behavior, specify now):
- Preserve formulas? (default: yes)
- Preserve formatting for a particular sheet or range? (provide sheet name/range)
- Any sheets to exclude from cleaning? (list names)

Tell me which option (1, 2, or 3) and any specifics. If you confirm option 3, I will proceed to edit and overwrite the original.
